constraints: The RTL implements a first-order masked S-box with two random shares and registered nonlinear processing.
The design includes benign share registers and one flawed recombination register.
The leakage model is Hamming-distance based.

functional_requirements.requirement: The submitted vulnerability_report.json must be valid JSON and parseable by a standard JSON parser.
The report must contain the three required fields: "recombination_net", "recombination_register", and "leakage_type", each with a non-empty string value.
The values for "recombination_net" and "recombination_register" must be valid hierarchical identifiers present in the provided RTL netlist.

interface: The participant must submit a single JSON file at submission/vulnerability_report.json. The file must contain an object with the following required fields: "recombination_net" (string, the exact hierarchical name of the net where shares recombine), "recombination_register" (string, the exact hierarchical name of the register that captures the recombined value), and "leakage_type" (string, a brief description of the leakage mechanism, e.g., "first-order switching leakage").
objective: Analyze the provided masked S-box RTL and identify the exact net and register where two individually masked shares are recombined in a single cycle, creating a first-order switching leakage point.
